evidence: FailureIntelligence remains the sole owner of failure evidence and derives negative procedures without a second registry.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep negative procedures as projections unless a separately justified lifecycle emerges.

evidence: The projection depends only on persisted failure and linked memory fields already required by failure intelligence.
dimensions.recommendation: Do not couple this read path to skill installation or execution.

evidence: The service and CLI require exact scope and task class, expose rejection reasons, and label authority as planning_constraint_only.
dimensions.recommendation: Version the interface before adding cross-scope aggregation.

evidence: Failure records remain authoritative; the command performs no write and no schema migration is required.
dimensions.recommendation: Continue resolving or reinforcing source failures rather than editing derived procedures.

evidence: Focused tests cover repetition gates, evidence gates, global-scope rejection, resolution invalidation, authority labeling, planner blocking, and CLI output.
dimensions.recommendation: Add cross-scope fixtures before designing any global rule contract.

evidence: Caller-supplied evidence references can appear distinct without proving independent observations.
impact_path: A producer submits three labels for one underlying event.
The repeated deterministic gate is satisfied.
A scoped planning prohibition may be stronger than the underlying evidence.
dimensions.recommendation: Bind future high-impact prohibitions to independently verified run receipts.

evidence: Projection, eligibility, identifiers, and ordering are deterministic and model independent.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep semantic generalization outside this contract until benchmarked.

evidence: A derived value type and assessment boundary can be replaced without migrating authoritative failure data.
dimensions.recommendation: Retain reason codes or provide a compatibility mapping in future assessors.

abstractions.purpose: Expose narrowly scoped what-not-to-do guidance from repeated failure evidence without creating executable authority.
use_evidence: Used by the runtime service and failure negatives CLI command.
complexity_cost: Two immutable value types and one deterministic assessment method; no new tables.
abstractions.recommendation: Retain the projection instead of adding a negative-skill registry.
